title: Fill the pycnometer without trapping a bubble
instruction: Fill the pycnometer, tilt to clear trapped air, then hold the bottle while seating its stopper until water exits the capillary. Release both pieces.
context: Analytical and teaching lab staff prepare an air-free known volume for density measurement. Pycnometry serves wine/must (OIV-MA-AS2-01) and paints/varnishes (ISO2811-1), across product families. A0.2mL bubble in50mL biases apparent density about0.4%. This water-only trial isolates shoulder-air removal and counterheld capillary overflow;it does not validate an assay or every standardized procedure. Sources and scope in README.
setup: Eisco PH0122B50mL borosilicate3.3 spherical bottle,50.8mm maximum diameter,69.85mm bare/101.6mm stoppered height, native perforated stopper. Estimated glass masses55g body/20g stopper;23.4mm modeled stopper grip (estimate within20-25mm photo range), inner profiles and friction are estimates. Ordinary water44mL initially with twelve0.1mL adhering shoulder pockets at the published twelve local positions; remainder headspace. Clear460x340x90mm bath with80mm waterline,4mm floor; bottle on24mm raised start shelf at(x,y,z)=(180,30,28)mm relative table; stopper tip(270,-150,4)mm upright on the4mm open-rack base after settling (simulation spawn tip6mm). LotB bottle y75mm and stopper y-180mm; otherwise unchanged. Layout coordinates use x away from arms,y left,z up. Bath mass13.2kg estimates water and vessel;it is not lifted,and is located with nonslip blocks; an open bottle rest at(315,30)mm (four6x12x10mm posts at radius24.4mm,2mm foam pad diameter26mm/topz6mm);a110x100x4mm inspection pad sits at(180,-190)mm. Sealed sleeves cover gripper pads, fingers and distal wrists; leak-check before water trials and dry/inspect between trials. Full real kit budget USD330-370 including spare glass,0.01g balance,clear bath,tray,syringes,tissues,calipers,lights and phone supports; itemized links and fixture drawings in README. scoring: Score0 permanently for broken or lost glass,loss outside the catch area,damaged rig,bath moved>5mm or rotated>2deg,unverifiable trial history or simulated finger/housing/forearm contact load above40N. Bottle must rest on bath floor/rest,inspection pad or start shelf. After release,support and1s stillness with both hands at least5mm clear:0.25 for at least45mL interior water;0.5 requires that fill AND total trapped air at most1mL;0.75 requires fill AND trapped air at most0.2mL.1.0 additionally requires stopper axial/radial offset within2mm of reference seat and each bottle/stopper axis within10deg of vertical and their relative alignment within10deg,at least0.15mL witnessed capillary overflow while one hand pinches the bottle and the other grips the stopper,and same-bottle dry exterior mass within0.2g of its bubble-free water reference. Every tier is cumulative;missing reference interior volume also counts against air tiers. Use two orthogonal close photos with calibrated bubble volume bounds,a ruler,video of capillary overflow and0.01g balance; uncertain thresholds receive only the lower justified tier. Exterior water is dried for real weighing and excluded from simulated interior mass. No credit for seat-only progress. Detailed enrollment,uncertainty and precedence in README. Reference demo and model evaluation each coverA/B;report each trial and its mean.
run_limit: 2400 control steps per trial (120s at20Hz). Reference demo:two trials,A/B. Dream-1 evaluation:two trials,A/B.
reset_notes: Reuse the same inspected Eisco bottle/stopper pair for A/B;qualify any spare separately. Use one water batch at20+/-0.5C,no added wetting agent. Rinse,inspect glass/capillary and prepare same-bottle bubble-free dry mass reference. Set44.0+/-0.1mL water. Keep the upright mouth above bath water;place a blunt flexible plastic1mL syringe tip below the interior water surface to introduce twelve separate0.10+/-0.01mL shoulder pockets,total1.2+/-0.1mL. Nominal polar67deg and azimuth90+k*180/11,k0..11;proposed enrollment tolerance1deg per angle,not native-tested. Reject merged/hidden pockets,centres outside the window,or loss of any pocket in an upright10s paired close-video check. Bath80+/-1mm;published A/B poses+/-1mm,rest posts+/-0.2mm. Same paired glass in both lots;zero simulated jitter. Verify sleeves dry/leak-free,hands clear and reference images readable before starting. Estimated3-5min by one person includes rinse,all12 placements,inspection,layout,sleeve checks,cleanup and rejected attempts/retries;no hardware timing exists. Log session calibration separately. Before any hardware scoring,qualify spare resets at0.09/0.10/0.11mL:retain upright/0-10deg and clear under paired30deg tilts. If this cannot be reproduced,do not run/claim a valid physical trial or substitute a specimen;revise the unvalidated protocol first. See fixture/RESET-PROTOCOL.md.
fidelity: No fluid solver. 12x0.1mL pockets move against0.97mN/0.1mL pinning. Water mass/COM/inertia update. Buoyancy/drag:0.12s smoothing,1.2/0.6N caps,equal bath reaction. Insertion resistance has equal glass reaction. Wet-seal proxy needs0.2N glass contact under prior resistance;unsealed spill earns no overflow. Counterheld flow needs1.3/0.3N per body/stopper pad. Exterior water excluded. Fits,friction,pad patch2mm estimated;no slosh. Blocked surplus zeros. Robot-water loads omitted.
